name: After recital S
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: Sa. whereas overly complex and prescriptive EU legislation, including cumulative environmental, climate and administrative requirements, increases construction and renovation costs, prolongs permitting procedures and restricts housing supply; whereas rising energy and utility costs as well as inflation, linked in part to regulatory requirements and geopolitical instability, have aggravated housing affordability challenges; whereas certain disproportionate or inflexible requirements stemming from EU environmental and energy legislation risks limiting access to affordable housing and renovation; whereas regulatory simplification and streamlined permitting procedures are essential to boost housing supply and renovation across Europe;
